noise_source: how far the test regions' daily leads stray from what the control regions predict (fit over 82 days, R squared 0.38)
verdict: Readable. A lift of 20% in leads needs 18 measured days, planned as 21 days so every weekday counts the same.

plan.change: Pause all campaigns in the test cities

official: Test and control regions are targeted with the Presence location option.
Holdback and go dark campaigns each keep their own budget. No budget is shared across test and control.
Budgets move less than 20% during the test: the geo test guidance says a larger change starts a new learning period.
practitioner: Ads, keywords and bids are the same in test and control regions.
The outcome is counted the same way in every region: the business's own leads or sales by region.

decision_rule: On 2026-12-06, run the readout with the pre-period 2026-09-14 to 2026-11-15. If the 95% interval for the change in leads in the test regions is entirely below zero, the ads cause leads at that size: compare the cost of each incremental one with what it is worth to the business. If the interval includes zero, the test found no effect of 18% or more.

checks: Cost in the go dark or holdback regions is zero, or the planned level for a heavy up.
The control regions spent at their usual level.
The business's leads or sales by region arrived for every day.
No campaign added or changed location targets during the test.
Do not call the result from a weekly look. Read it once, on the stop date.
